## 🧭 Implementation Plan: Bookmark Manager

**Artifacts** in `specs/001-bookmark-manager/`: `plan.md`, `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `contracts/api.md`, `contracts/search-grammar.md`, `quickstart.md`.

### Technical approach (the decisions to review)

| Area | Choice | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| **Shape** | One Node.js 24 + Express service serving both UI and API, `npm start` on `0.0.0.0:4000` | Matches the review runtime; single user doesn't need a separate SPA |
| **Storage** | Embedded SQLite (`better-sqlite3`); page copies as files on disk | No external DB server; durable across restarts |
| **Metadata** | Read `<title>`/description/OG/Twitter/favicon via fetch + Cheerio, with Playwright/Chromium fallback for JS-heavy pages | Cheap for most pages, best-effort per spec |
| **Search** | Hand-written parser → AST, evaluated over all text fields | Your exact semantics (implicit-AND, quoted-operator-as-literal, `#tag`) aren't what stock engines do by default |
| **Page copy** | Chromium inlines resources into one self-contained HTML file; PDFs stored as-is; Internet Archive via Save Page Now | Opens offline, readable (not pixel-perfect), as you approved |
| **Import/export** | Netscape bookmark HTML via Cheerio, merge-by-URL | De-facto browser interchange format |
| **Notes** | Store Markdown, render with `marked` + sanitize with DOMPurify | Formatted display, safe |
| **Tests** | `node --test` for parser/metadata/import-export; Playwright Test **pinned 1.61.0** | Matches installed browser revision |

### Data model
Entities: **Bookmark** (with read/archived flags, page-copy refs, archive.org link, timestamps), **Tag** (case-insensitive unique), **bookmark_tags**, **SavedFilter**, **Preferences** (single row). Full field tables in `data-model.md`.

`contracts/api.md` covers all endpoints (incl. `bulk` with "select all in results", import/export, page-copy, archive.org). `contracts/search-grammar.md` gives the EBNF + a worked-examples table mapping directly to your US4 acceptance scenarios.
